consequence.statement: Before upgrading, clusters using external workloads must have a cluster name and ID specified, or explicitly opt out of KVStoreMesh, because KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default.
consequence.remediation: Specify the cluster name and ID before upgrading, or explicitly disable KVStoreMesh.

assertion.statement: KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default; clusters using external workloads must set a cluster name and ID before upgrading, or explicitly opt out of KVStoreMesh.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Evidence does not name the Helm value or config key for external workloads, KVStoreMesh opt-out, or cluster name/ID, so exposure cannot be expressed without guessing.
